title: Verde Valley to Painted Desert
subtitle: Columbus Day weekend, Oct 9–12, 2026: the Verde Valley and Flagstaff monuments plus Petrified Forest on Saturday, the Navajo Nation on Sunday, then Tonto, Casa Grande and Saguaro on the way home. Laid out in the order it actually happened; clock times are from the plan.

days.title: Fly to Phoenix
days.html:
✈︎

OAK → PHX after work

Flight 768, 8:15 → 10:15 PM. Picked up the Enterprise Intermediate (Costco Travel) at the Sky Harbor Rental Car Center, then about 30 minutes north.

Slept at the Best Western Plus Executive Residency Phoenix North Happy Valley, 2108 W Whispering Wind Dr.

How it went: Petrified Forest moved up to Saturday, which freed Sunday for the Navajo Nation, and Tonto was added Monday morning. 11 new stamps in all, bringing the total to 49.

days.title: Verde Valley to the Painted Desert
days.sub: Happy Valley → Montezuma → Tuzigoot → Walnut Canyon → Sunset Crater → Petrified Forest → Chambers
days.cut: Five stamps as planned, then Petrified Forest a day early, before its 5 PM gate lock.

days.title: Into the Navajo Nation
days.sub: Chambers → Hubbell → Canyon de Chelly → Navajo NM → Phoenix
days.tzline: Arizona time · Navajo Nation is 1 hr ahead
days.cut: Navajo Nation keeps daylight saving time, so all three sites ran an hour ahead of the phone in Chambers. Times here are Arizona time with Navajo time in brackets.

days.title: Tonto, Casa Grande, Saguaro
days.sub: Phoenix → Tonto → Casa Grande → Saguaro West → PHX
days.cut: Tonto was the stretch goal and made it in by starting at 6 AM, stamp-and-go at every stop. Saguaro made 15 of the 63 national parks.

stops.name: Montezuma Castle NM
stops.addr: Montezuma Castle National Monument Visitor Center
stops.hrs: Paved 0.3-mile loop to the castle view.
stops.about: A five-story Sinagua cliff dwelling tucked into a limestone alcove about 90 feet above Beaver Creek, built around 1100–1425.

stops.via: Same monument, separate entrance near Rimrock.
stops.name: Montezuma Well
stops.note: A limestone sinkhole fed by a spring, with a short paved path to the overlook. No fee.

stops.name: Tuzigoot NM
stops.hrs: Paved overlook trail around the hilltop pueblo.
stops.about: A Sinagua pueblo of about 110 rooms crowning a ridge above the Verde River.

stops.via: Up to Flagstaff, with lunch in town.
stops.name: Walnut Canyon NM
stops.hrs: The rim overlook is paved; the canyon-floor loop is all stairs, so it was skipped.
stops.about: Cliff rooms built by the Sinagua into the ledges of a 400-foot-deep limestone canyon.

stops.name: Sunset Crater Volcano NM
stops.addr: Sunset Crater Volcano National Monument Visitor Center
stops.hrs: Closed at 4:30 PM, the tightest stop of the planned day.
stops.about: A cinder cone that erupted around 1085, the youngest volcano on the Colorado Plateau, its rim tinted red and yellow.

stops.via: I-40 east to the park’s north entrance.
stops.name: Petrified Forest NP
stops.addr: Painted Desert Visitor Center, Petrified Forest National Park
stops.ok: Moved up from Sunday’s plan, and a new park for the 63.
stops.about: Fallen trees from about 225 million years ago turned to quartz, set in the banded hills of the Painted Desert.

stops.name: Chambers, AZ
stops.addr: SureStay by Best Western Chambers Petrified Forest
stops.note: SureStay by Best Western Chambers Petrified Forest, right off I-40. Still on regular Arizona time here.

stops.via: US-191 north to Ganado. The Navajo Nation’s clock is an hour ahead from here.
stops.name: Hubbell Trading Post NHS
stops.addr: Hubbell Trading Post National Historic Site
stops.about: The oldest continuously operating trading post on the Navajo Nation, trading since 1878.

stops.name: Canyon de Chelly NM
stops.addr: Canyon de Chelly National Monument Welcome Center
stops.hrs: 8 AM – 5 PM Navajo time. South Rim overlooks are roadside pull-offs.
stops.about: Sheer sandstone canyons where Navajo families still live and farm, inside the monument on Navajo land.

stops.via: Northwest across the reservation toward Kayenta.
stops.name: Navajo NM
stops.hrs: Stamp desk closes 5 PM Navajo time (4 PM Arizona clock).
stops.about: Protects Betatakin and Keet Seel, two of the best-preserved Ancestral Puebloan cliff villages, in remote canyons.

stops.via: Kayenta → Tuba City → Flagstaff → I-17 south, with a meal and gas stop.
stops.name: Phoenix area
stops.note: Night 3 was booked day-of near Phoenix, as close as possible to Monday’s 6 AM start toward Tonto.

stops.via: US-60 through Globe, then AZ-188. Not the Apache Trail (AZ-88), which was closed.
stops.name: Tonto NM
stops.ok: The stretch goal, and it made it.
stops.about: Salado cliff dwellings built in the 1300s in caves above Roosevelt Lake.

stops.via: Back through Globe and down to Coolidge.
stops.name: Casa Grande Ruins NM
stops.hrs: Free entry. Flat, paved paths around the Great House.
stops.about: A four-story caliche Great House built by the Ancestral Sonoran Desert People around 1350, the first archaeological reserve in the U.S. (1892).

stops.via: I-10 east to Tucson, then west over Gates Pass to the Red Hills Visitor Center.
stops.name: Saguaro NP
stops.addr: Red Hills Visitor Center, Saguaro National Park
stops.ok: National park number 15 of 63, and stamp 49 overall.
stops.about: Forests of giant saguaro cacti on both sides of Tucson, split into two districts.

stops.title: Phoenix → home
stops.note: Returned the car at Sky Harbor with hours to spare, then Flight 2959, 8:40 → 10:40 PM to Oakland. 11 new stamps.
